retrievalProfile.description: A symmetrical urban collage featuring a central portrait with reflective eyewear, flanked by speakers and city elements in a high-contrast desaturated palette.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, symmetrical digital collage centered on a close-up male portrait wearing dark sunglasses. The sunglasses reflect stylized text and a lens flare. The portrait is surrounded by urban motifs including brick walls, city skylines, large audio speakers, and classic cars, all rendered in a high-contrast, desaturated sepia-toned palette with glowing gold highlights.
coreVisualRelationships: Central portrait as the primary focal point
Symmetrical arrangement of speakers and cars at the base
Text integrated into the reflection of the eyewear
Urban textures like brick and concrete framing the subject
coreInvariants: High-contrast desaturated color grading with selective gold/yellow glows
Symmetrical balance across the vertical axis
Integration of city architecture and audio equipment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central portrait occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bridge of the nose and the sunglasses reflection.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the glowing text in the sunglasses, moves down the face to the symmetrical speakers, and out to the city skyline edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is a dense 'horror vacui' style collage.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated olive-grey and black for the base imagery.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the shadows and sunglasses.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Glowing gold and warm yellow for text reflections and lens flares.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to sepia, grey, black, and gold

letterConstructionRules: Curved to follow the contour of the sunglass lenses
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are mirrored or reflected vertically to simulate a glass surface reflection
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary blocky sans-serif for metadata labels at the bottom.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base geometric width for the skeleton.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a symmetrical urban collage in desaturated sepia tones. Center a close-up male face wearing large black sunglasses. Surround the face with brick walls, city buildings, and two large audio speakers at the bottom corners. Add two classic cars at the very bottom. Use high contrast and deep shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom geometric inline lettering inside the sunglass lenses. The text should glow gold and follow the curve of the lens. Add a bright white lens flare at the top corner of the left lens.

verificationChecks: Does the text appear as a glowing reflection in the glasses?
Is the color palette restricted to desaturated tones and gold?
Are the speakers and cars balanced on both sides?

adjustableVariables: Facial expression of the central subject
Type of cars used at the base
postGenerationChecks: Verify the glow effect doesn't blow out the text legibility
Ensure the urban textures (brick, metal) are distinct
Confirm the desaturated palette is consistent across all collage elements
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical Urban Collage + Reflective Eyewear + Desaturated Gold Palette
